{{CharInfobox |color={{autumn color}} |corecolor={{autumn color light}} |bordercolor={{autumn color dark}} |name=Morrison |jname=マサムネ |tmname=Masamune |slogan=no |image=Morrison.png |size=250px |caption=Morrison |gender=Male |colors=yes |eyes=Black |hair=Orange |hometown=[[Verdanturf Town]] |region=[[Hoenn]] |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=AG118 |epname=Less is Morrison |java=[[Masako Nozawa]] |enva=[[Sean Schemmel]] }} '''Morrison''' (Japanese: '''マサムネ''' ''Masamune'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] from [[Verdanturf Town]] and a [[rival]] of {{Ash}}. He dresses in traditional Japanese attire. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|RS}}==== [[File:Ash and Morrison.png|thumb|left|220px|Morrison and Ash]] Morrison first appeared in ''[[AG118|Less is Morrison]]'', chasing a runaway {{tt|rice ball|sandwich in the English dub}}. Ash caught the snack and was about to give it to him but {{TP|May|Munchlax}} ended up gobbling it away. Morrison felt miserable about Munchlax taking his snack but felt better afterwards. He revealed to Ash and {{ashfr}} that he was planning on entering the [[Hoenn League]] and winning it. Ash was planning on doing the same, starting a friendly rivalry between the two Trainers.  After arguing on who is better, Morrison accepted Ash's decision on having a battle. Morrison sent out his {{TP|Morrison|Beldum}} against [[Ash's Pikachu]]. Despite Beldum using Take Down continuously, the battle ended in a draw. He ran off after finding out that Ash had all of the Hoenn [[Badge]]s already. He met up with Ash near a Pokémon Center and they had a race to see who could get there first, which ended in a draw. Morrison then challenged Ash to various contests such as a food eating contest. In the middle of one of their contests, {{TRT}} showed up and snatched Pikachu and Beldum. They placed Morrison and his rival in a cage. Both Trainers successfully broke out of the cage they were in with their Take Down techniques, as they left all of their Pokémon (except for Pikachu and Beldum) behind. Ash and Morrison ran very fast and jumped onto [[Team Rocket's mechas|Team Rocket's balloon]]. They had a battle with them by treating themselves as Pokémon. They were able to free Pikachu and Beldum, which then blasted off Team Rocket. Morrison reappeared during the [[Ever Grande Conference]] arc. In ''[[AG126|Saved By The Beldum]]'', he announced that he won his final Badge. Seeing Ash's full team, Morrison revealed his whole team including Beldum. He declared himself as a rival to Ash for the tournament. During the preliminaries, Morrison's first opponent was {{OBP|Jump|AG126}}. The battle began with an overwhelming start as Beldum's Take Down was continuously blocked by {{m|Protect}}. Since Beldum can only use Take Down, Morrison was at a disadvantage. As Morrison was about to be eliminated, Beldum started to [[Evolution|evolve]] into a Metang. Morrison defeated his opponent by having Metang use {{m|Confusion}} to stop Electabuzz and used Take Down to finish it off. In ''[[AG127|From Brags to Riches]]'', Morrison was paired up with [[Gavin]] as his opponent in the second round of the Ever Grande Conference, which consists of Double Battles. He sent out {{p|Growlithe}} and {{p|Gligar}} while Gavin used {{p|Machamp}} and {{p|Marowak}}. His Growlithe lost to Marowak while Gligar took out Machamp first and then Marowak when both sides were down to one Pokémon. In ''[[AG129|A Judgment Brawl]]'', Morrison defeated a Trainer with a {{p|Machoke}} and found out that he had to battle Ash as his next opponent, something that both of them did not expect. This saddened Morrison as he was not yet ready to battle Ash. During their battle, Morrison felt so bad about battling Ash that he initially only attempted to defend and quickly lost two of his Pokémon to {{AP|Corphish}}. Ash managed to snap him out of his funk, making him realize he wasn't being fair to his Pokémon who were relying on him. Now finally battling properly, he sent out {{p|Swampert}} as his third Pokémon and tied with Corphish. Their battle continued in ''[[AG130|Choose It or Lose It!]]'', where Morrison was finally giving his all. His {{p|Steelix}} knocked out two of his Pokémon before losing to {{AP|Grovyle}}. When both sides were down to one Pokémon, he was left with Metang while Ash was left with {{AP|Glalie}}. After a tough battle, Glalie was victorious despite the type-disadvantage. Morrison stayed around and left after the Ever Grande Conference was over. ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== [[File:Morrison party.png|thumb|220px|Morrison's party prior to Beldum's Evolution]] In ''[[JN118|Battling as Hard as Stone!]]'', Morrison was seen watching {{an|Steven Stone|Steven}}'s [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against Ash on [[television]]. ===Character=== Morrison has a very spirited personality, and he likes to challenge other people to almost everything. Due to this, he usually challenges Ash to various events such as Pokémon battles, racing each other, or even a food eating contest. His personality seems to mirror Ash's during the [[Indigo Plateau Conference]]; frequently showing signs of immaturity and overconfidence. Though when faced with tough situations, such as having to battle someone whom he considers a good friend, he doesn't always know what to do and will become depressed. This is seen after Morrison learned Ash would be his next opponent in the Ever Grande Conference. It also shows that he doesn't hold winning to a higher degree of importance over friendship. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Morrison's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Morrison |pkmn=Metang |stage1=Beldum |type1=Steel |type2=Psychic |img=Morrison Metang.png |epnum=AG118 |epname=Less is Morrison |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |vaen=Katsuyuki Konishi |desc={{p|Metang}} is Morrison's main Pokémon and is usually seen [[Walking Pokémon|outside its Poké Ball]]. It first appeared as a Beldum in ''[[AG118|Less is Morrison]]'', where it had a battle with [[Ash's Pikachu]] and tied. Morrison relied on it when he competed in the [[Ever Grande Conference]], where it evolved into Metang during the battle with {{OBP|Jump|AG126}}'s {{p|Electabuzz}}. Since then, it helped Morrison progress through the rounds until his battle with {{Ash}}, where it was beaten by his {{AP|Glalie}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Morrison |pkmn=Girafarig |type1=Normal |type2=Psychic |img=Morrison Girafarig.png |epnum=AG126 |epname=Saved by the Beldum |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen=Rachael Lillis |desc=Morrison's {{p|Girafarig}} was seen along with Morrison's other Pokémon during their introduction, but its battle skills are not so well known, as it was only briefly seen during Morrison's battle with Ash. As Morrison was unwilling to battle against Ash, he gave Girafarig very few commands to attack and even called for an ineffective Light Screen against {{m|Vise Grip}}, resulting in it being quickly defeated by [[Ash's Corphish]]'s {{m|Crabhammer}}. Girafarig's known moves are {{m|Light Screen}}, {{m|Tackle}}, and {{m|Iron Tail}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Morrison |pkmn=Growlithe |type1=Fire |img=Morrison Growlithe.png |epnum=AG126 |epname=Saved by the Beldum |vajp=Shin-ichiro Miki |vaen=Maddie Blaustein |desc=Morrison's {{p|Growlithe}} was seen for the first time when Morrison introduced his Pokémon to Ash and company. Later he used it in his Double Battle with [[Gavin]] along with his Gligar. In the battle, Growlithe took Gavin's {{p|Marowak}} as its main target. Despite pulling a good battle, Growlithe was eventually knocked out by Marowak's {{m|Bone Club}}. Later, Morrison sent Growlithe out in his battle with Ash to face Ash's {{p|Corphish}}. Being unwilling to battle with his friend, Morrison just kept Growlithe dodging attacks, but it was quickly knocked out by a Crabhammer after slipping on the ice battlefield. Growlithe's known moves are {{m|Take Down}}, {{m|Flamethrower}}, and {{m|Agility}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Morrison |pkmn=Swampert |type1=Water |type2=Ground |img=Morrison Swampert.png |epnum=AG126 |epname=Saved by the Beldum |vajp=Unshō Ishizuka |vaen=Darren Dunstan |desc=Morrison's {{p|Swampert}} was seen along with other of Morrison's Pokémon as he showed his team for Ash and the others. He later used Swampert in his battle against Ash, now willing to battle him, sending it against Ash's Corphish. Both Pokémon launched their attacks simultaneously and hit each other at the same time, and they were both knocked out. Swampert's known moves are {{m|Focus Punch}} and {{m|Hydro Pump}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Morrison |pkmn=Steelix |type1=Steel |type2=Ground |img=Morrison Steelix.png |epnum=AG126 |epname=Saved by the Beldum |vajp=Kōichi Sakaguchi |vaen=Kōichi Sakaguchi |desc=Morrison's {{p|Steelix}} was seen for the first time when Morrison introduced his Pokémon for Ash and his friends. In his battle against Ash, Morrison first sent his Steelix out against [[Ash's Pikachu]], which the Iron Snake Pokémon easily defeated. Steelix's subsequent opponent was [[Ash's Torkoal]], which it also managed to take down. Steelix's third and final opponent was {{AP|Grovyle}}, which proved to be too much to handle and claimed victory with a powerful {{m|Leaf Blade}}. Steelix's known moves are {{m|Dragon Breath}}, {{m|Iron Tail}}, and {{m|Dig}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Morrison |pkmn=Gligar |type1=Ground |type2=Flying |img=Morrison Gligar.png |epnum=AG126 |epname=Saved by the Beldum |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |vaen=Katsuyuki Konishi |desc=Morrison's {{p|Gligar}} appeared for the first time when Morrison showed his Pokémon team for Ash and {{ashfr}}. He used it in the next episode in his Double Battle against Gavin along with his Growlithe. In the battle, Gligar took Gavin's {{p|Machamp}} as its main target and was finally able to finish it. It then battled against Gavin's Marowak after it defeated Growlithe and won against it as well. Later, Morrison used Gligar in his battle against Ash. It defeated [[Ash's Grovyle]] after landing a hit with Guillotine and tied with [[Ash's Swellow]]. Gligar's known moves are {{m|Guillotine}}, {{m|Steel Wing}}, {{m|Iron Tail}}, and {{m|Hidden Power}}.}} ===Achievements=== [[File:Morrison Last Badge.png|thumb|220px|Morrison's eighth Badge]] ====Badges obtained==== This listing is of the [[Badge]]s Morrison has obtained in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]]: * Seven unknown Badges (prior to ''[[AG118|Less is Morrison]]'') * Unknown Badge (prior to ''[[AG126|Saved By The Beldum]]'') ====Pokémon League==== Morrison has competed in the following [[Pokémon League Conference]]s: * [[Ever Grande Conference]] - Top 16 (''[[AG130|Choose It or Lose It!]]'') ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{autumn color}}|bordercolor={{autumn color light}} |ja=野沢雅子 ''[[Masako Nozawa]]'' |en=[[Sean Schemmel]] |fr_eu=Romain Barbieux ([[AG118]])
